title: Flat Monthly Rate Table, Montgomery GI Bill and Chapter 35
content:
**Rate table — flat monthly rates of Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).** Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 pay the student a flat monthly amount for a full month of training; the Post-9/11 GI Bill levels pay no flat monthly rate (their figure is $0.00) because they pay tuition, housing and books instead.

| Tier | Full time | Three-quarter time | Half time | Less than half time (maximum; never more than tuition and fees) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | $493.00 | $368.00 | $243.00 | $123.25 |
| Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) | $1536.00 | $1214.00 | $804.00 | $384.00 |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | $2518.00 | $1888.50 | $1259.00 | $629.50 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 60% Benefit Level | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 80% Benefit Level | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 90% Benefit Level | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 100% Benefit Level | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |

Plain figures for reference: Chapter 1606 — 493, 368, 243 and 123.25; Chapter 35 — 1536, 1214, 804 and 384; Chapter 30 — 2518, 1888.5, 1259 and 629.5.

**Points of reading**

- Each figure is the amount for a full month. The less-than-half-time figure is a ceiling rather than a fixed amount: the amount for less-than-half-time training is never more than the tuition and fees charged.
- The figures differ by chapter, not by school: a Chapter 30 student and a Chapter 1606 student at the same school and the same training time are paid from different rows.
- *Hypothetical comparison:* at three-quarter time a full month is $1888.50 on Chapter 30, $1214.00 on Chapter 35 and $368.00 on Chapter 1606.
